citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:07 am on July
20,2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone call and left a voicemail. Licensee returned call within
30 minutes stating he was out of town and unavailable. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for
inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
